Package io.telekom.orchest.api.core.utils

Class JsonMapper

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.api.core.utils.JsonMapper
public class JsonMapper extends Object
Utility class for JSON serialization and deserialization using Jackson. Provides configured ObjectMapper instances and helper methods for common operations.
